cases.detail:
WITH base AS (
SELECT
  analytics_nonadditive_totals.region AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.region", MEASURE(analytics_nonadditive_totals.average) AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.average", MEASURE(analytics_nonadditive_totals.samples) AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.samples", MEASURE(analytics_nonadditive_totals.distinct) AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.distinct", MEASURE(analytics_nonadditive_totals.total) AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.total", MEASURE(analytics_nonadditive_totals.weighted_native) AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.weighted_native", MEASURE(analytics_nonadditive_totals.total) AS "sum_state", MEASURE(analytics_nonadditive_totals.samples) AS "sample_state"
  FROM analytics_nonadditive_totals
  WHERE analytics_nonadditive_totals.id < '0'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  base."analytics_nonadditive_totals.region" AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.region", base."analytics_nonadditive_totals.average" AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.average", base."analytics_nonadditive_totals.samples" AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.samples", base."analytics_nonadditive_totals.distinct" AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.distinct", base."analytics_nonadditive_totals.total" AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.total", base."analytics_nonadditive_totals.weighted_native" AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.weighted_native", ((CAST(base."sum_state" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) / NULLIF(base."sample_state", 0)) AS "weighted"
  FROM base
  ORDER BY "analytics_nonadditive_totals.region"
  LIMIT 100

  COUNT(*) AS "__anchor"
  FROM analytics_nonadditive_totals
  WHERE analytics_nonadditive_totals.id < '0'
),

SELECT
  analytics_nonadditive_totals.region AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.region", MEASURE(analytics_nonadditive_totals.average) AS "wrong_average"
  FROM analytics_nonadditive_totals
  WHERE analytics_nonadditive_totals.id < '0'
  GROUP BY 1
),
nested AS (
SELECT
  AVG(nested_input."wrong_average") AS "wrong_average"
  FROM nested_input
),
nested_input_2 AS (
SELECT
  analytics_nonadditive_totals.region AS "analytics_nonadditive_totals.region", MEASURE(analytics_nonadditive_totals.distinct) AS "wrong_distinct"
  FROM analytics_nonadditive_totals
  WHERE analytics_nonadditive_totals.id < '0'
  GROUP BY 1
),
nested_2 AS (
SELECT
  SUM(nested_input_2."wrong_distinct") AS "wrong_distinct"
  FROM nested_input_2
),
combined AS (
SELECT
  nested."wrong_average" AS "wrong_average", nested_2."wrong_distinct" AS "wrong_distinct"
  FROM base CROSS JOIN nested CROSS JOIN nested_2
)
